messages: It seems the Arcforging master #p602# of #m10005000# is finally ready to recognize my Arcforging skills.
The Arcforging master, #p602# of #m10005000#, was impressed with my growth and challenged me to prove my skill. I need to defeat #r#o19#s#k and craft #b1 #t4020106##k to bring back to him.

Amazed by my craftsmanship, the Arcforging master #p602# of #m10005000# handed me a #t4130003#. It appears to be a special item that can be used during crafting to create even stronger scrolls. Should I give it a try?
name: An Arcforger in My Own Right!
